summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting per the spec. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and widens ControlCode with Tuple[ControlType, str]; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes one two-item tuple; rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool gated only on is_terminal, with the required docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once per title control; CHANGELOG.md adds an Added bullet linking PR 2200 above Fixed; tests added to test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py (the last skipped off Windows). Nothing was run: no tests, black, or mypy, per instructions. Nothing was committed.
